shortcuts.minus6Multi: Select the six consecutive months ending at the reference month (anchor included)
shortcuts.minus6Single: Go to the first month of the six-month window ending at the reference month
shortcuts.minus3Multi: Select the three consecutive months ending at the reference month (anchor included)
shortcuts.minus3Single: Go to the first month of the three-month window ending at the reference month
shortcuts.minus1Multi: Select only the month immediately before the reference month
shortcuts.minus1Single: Go to the month immediately before the reference month
shortcuts.currentMulti: Select only the current calendar month (today)
shortcuts.currentSingle: Go to the current calendar month (today)
shortcuts.plus1Multi: Select only the month immediately after the reference month
shortcuts.plus1Single: Go to the month immediately after the reference month
shortcuts.plus3Multi: Select three consecutive months starting from the reference month (anchor included)
shortcuts.plus3Single: Go to the last month of the three-month window starting from the reference month
shortcuts.plus6Multi: Select six consecutive months starting from the reference month (anchor included)
shortcuts.plus6Single: Go to the last month of the six-month window starting from the reference month
